textureLayerBudget.note: WebGPU devices commonly guarantee at least 256 2D-array layers. Raw material textures keep a margin so future furniture and robot variants do not create invalid bind groups.

estimatedDrawCalls.note: Raw WebGPU should collapse per-instance React objects into batch-level draw calls; GLB primitive fan-out is tracked in asset records.

estimatedTriangles.note: Triangle counts are estimated from GLB index accessor counts before meshopt decode; exact flattened geometry appears in compiler phase 2.
